setting: A student asks a shuttle driver about evening route changes during midterms.
narrator_intro: Listen to a conversation between a student and a campus shuttle driver.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Does this bus still go to the science complex after eight?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Not this week. During midterms we're on the exam schedule—after eight we only loop between the library, the dorms, and the student union.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: I have a review session in Science Hall at eight-thirty. How do I get there?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Take the seven-forty from the union to the library, then walk the covered path—it's about six minutes. Or catch the daytime science route; the last one leaves the union at seven-fifty-five.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Seven-fifty-five is tight. Is the covered path lit?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Yes, and Campus Safety patrols it until midnight during exams. If you miss both options, call the night van—students can request a ride with their ID.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Does the night van cost anything?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: No, it's free for enrolled students. You need to book it at least twenty minutes ahead on the transit app.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Okay. Will normal service to Science Hall resume next week?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Yes—starting Monday after exams. The change is only for midterm week. Check the app; it shows today's modified map in orange.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Thanks. I'll aim for the seven-fifty-five.

narrator_outro: Now get ready to answer the questions.

questions.narrator_text: What is the conversation mainly about?

options.A: Buying a monthly city bus pass
options.B: How to reach Science Hall during a temporary shuttle change
options.C: Reporting a broken elevator in the dorms
options.D: Canceling a review session with a professor

questions.explanation: Evening routes change during midterms; she explains how he can still get to Science Hall.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing A—campus shuttle changes, not a city pass, are the topic.

questions.narrator_text: After eight o'clock this week, where does the shuttle loop?

options.A: Only to the airport and downtown
options.B: Between the library, the dorms, and the student union
options.C: Everywhere including Science Hall as usual

questions.explanation: On the exam schedule after eight, the bus only loops library–dorms–union.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing C—Science Hall is not on the after-eight loop this week.

questions.narrator_text: What is true about the night van?

options.A: It costs five dollars per ride
options.B: It is free but must be booked at least twenty minutes ahead
options.D: It replaces all daytime buses permanently

questions.explanation: Free for enrolled students; book at least twenty minutes ahead on the transit app.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing A—she says it is free.

questions.narrator_text: When does normal service to Science Hall resume?

options.D: It never returns to Science Hall

questions.explanation: Normal service resumes Monday after exams; the change is only for midterm week.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing C—she ties the return to after midterms, not next semester.
